buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Neither player has a fatigue edge. Workloads are close, 22 games for Medvedev against 16 for Tiafoe over 14 days, and neither shows a rest or rhythm problem. They last played 3 and 3 days ago respectively.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Medvedev holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Medvedev is on the way up (+84 Elo over 90 days) while Tiafoe has been sliding (-24). Medvedev's last 10 run 7 pts above the season win rate, while Tiafoe is 27 pts below it.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Conditions point fairly clearly to Medvedev. Both rate below their overall level on Indoor Hard, but Medvedev holds up better (-29 Elo against -70 for Tiafoe). Medvedev is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 76% wins in 12 months against 64% for Tiafoe. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.
